verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline as the dominant element with a well-proportioned CTA and a clear logo→product→headline→CTA flow, though the logo and product are tiny and the decorative bubble sits awkwardly behind the button. B shrinks the headline and blows the 'Shop Now' button up so it competes with the headline and jams against the right edge, and its subline is cramped under the headline.

A has the oversized CTA that crowds the right edge and overpowers the shrunken headline, and the logo and product are tiny. B gives the headline proper dominance and a sensibly sized CTA, but it moves the product away from the brand into a cramped spot next to the button, where it overlaps the decorative bubble, and the logo is very small.

A again has the bloated CTA jammed at the right edge and a weak headline. B has a better headline and CTA hierarchy, but it pushes the product can against the left edge and moves the tiny Solstice logo to the right, where it floats on the busy bubble next to the CTA, which breaks the brand-first reading order.
